title: UI Server Script returning {} in frappe.call() response

posts.name: Saad Altaf Khan
posts.cooked:
Hi,

I created a Server Script (Type: API) in Frappe with the name expense_read_only and I’m calling it from a Custom Script:

javascript

function update_expense_field_read_only(frm){
    const item_code = frm.doc.items[0].item_code;
    console.log("Calling server with item_code:", item_code);
    frappe.call({
        method: "expense_read_only",  
        args: {
            item_code
            },
        callback: function(r) {
            console.log("Full server response:", r);
            if (r.message && r.message.read_only) {
                frm.set_df_property("custom_expenses_new_", "read_only", 1);
                frm.refresh_field("custom_expenses_new_");
            }
        }
    });
}

Server Script (API type):

python

def expense_read_only(item_code):
    si = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT si.posting_date
    FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
    JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON sii.parent = si.name
    WHERE sii.item_code = %s AND si.docstatus = 1
    ORDER BY si.posting_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
    """, (item_code,), as_dict=True)
    frappe.log_error(f"Sales Invoice query result: {si}")

    if si:
        si_date = si[0].posting_date
        expiry_date = frappe.utils.add_days(si_date, 28)
        today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())

        return {"read_only": today > expiry_date}
    
    return {"read_only": False}

No matter what I return, the browser console always shows {} for r.
I expected to get {"message": {"read_only": true}} in the response.

Is there something special about returning values from API-type Server Scripts so that they show up in r.message?
